faqs.q: Does HDFC Millennia cashback work on Swiggy orders under ₹150?
faqs.a: HDFC’s current MITC uses complete ₹100 transaction blocks. A qualifying direct Swiggy purchase below ₹100 earns no CashPoints under that rule. A purchase of ₹100–₹149 can earn on the first ₹100 if the merchant ID is eligible and there is cap remaining.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia cashback real cashback or reward points?
faqs.a: You earn HDFC CashPoints. You can redeem them for statement credit at ₹1 per CashPoint, subject to a 500-point minimum, a 3,000-point calendar-month redemption ceiling and ₹50 plus tax per redemption. Other redemption routes have different values.

faqs.q: Can I get the HDFC Millennia fee waived?
faqs.a: HDFC lists ₹1,000 plus applicable tax for renewal. Its fee schedule says to spend over ₹1 lakh in the year before renewal for the waiver. Confirm qualifying spend and the renewal period on your account. The separate quarterly milestone is a different benefit.

faqs.q: Is HDFC Millennia better than Amazon Pay ICICI?
faqs.a: For eligible Amazon.in goods, Amazon Pay ICICI can earn 5% with Prime or 3% without it, as Amazon Pay balance. Millennia’s 5% tier also covers nine other listed merchants, but they draw from the same calendar-month cap. Compare both on your own basket after membership and redemption costs.

faqs.q: What happens after I hit the ₹1,000 monthly cap?
faqs.a: The named-merchant and other eligible purchase buckets each have a 1,000-CashPoint calendar-month cap. When you exhaust the 5% bucket, further purchases in that bucket do not switch to 1%. Purchases eligible for the separate 1% bucket can still earn until its own cap. Use the settlement date to track each bucket.

faqs.q: Is SBI Cashback still worth it after the April 2026 changes?
faqs.a: It can be if your eligible online shopping outweighs the fee. The 5% bucket reaches its cap at ₹40,000 in a statement cycle. Compare the rewards on any online spend beyond that amount separately.

faqs.q: Does SBI Cashback give 5% on Swiggy or Zomato?
faqs.a: A direct order can qualify if SBI Card codes it as an eligible online purchase and there’s room in the online cap. Wallet loads and other excluded transactions earn nothing.

faqs.q: Is the cashback real money or points?
faqs.a: It is a credit to the card account, applied automatically within two working days of statement generation. There are no points to redeem.

faqs.q: How does SBI Cashback compare with HDFC Millennia?
faqs.a: SBI Cashback applies its 5% rate to eligible online transactions across merchants. HDFC Millennia limits its 5% tier to ten named merchants and pays in CashPoints. Millennia also has an optional domestic lounge voucher tied to its quarterly spend milestone.

faqs.q: Is the 1.5% base rate really uncapped?
faqs.a: Axis lists no cap on 1.5% cashback for other eligible purchases. The issuer’s excluded categories still earn zero, and the ₹500 cap applies separately to the 5% and 4% routes combined.

faqs.q: Does 5% work on all bill payments via Google Pay?
faqs.a: No. Use Axis ACE through Google Pay on Android for eligible electricity, water, gas, LPG, broadband, DTH or mobile recharges. Utility payments outside the specified route earn no cashback.

faqs.q: Axis ACE vs HDFC Millennia — which is better?
faqs.a: Compare the same eligible spending. ACE offers statement cashback with an Android bill-payment route and a shared cap for its accelerated rates. Millennia earns CashPoints, with one cap for its ten named merchants and another for other eligible spend. Account for fees and redemption costs.

faqs.q: Does Axis ACE earn on fuel?
faqs.a: Fuel earns no cashback. Axis lists a separate 1% surcharge waiver on eligible ₹400–₹4,000 fuel transactions, capped at ₹500 per statement. GST on the surcharge is not refunded.

faqs.q: What happens to accelerated cashback after ₹500 cap?
faqs.a: Once the eligible 5% and 4% transactions together reach ₹500 in a statement cycle, those transactions earn no further cashback for the cycle. Other eligible purchases still earn their separate 1.5% rate.

faqs.q: Do I need Amazon Prime to get 5%?
faqs.a: Yes, on eligible Amazon.in retail purchases. Non-Prime members earn 3% on that tier. Specified Amazon Pay routes, such as eligible digitally fulfilled categories and gift cards, use a separate 2% rate.

faqs.q: Can I convert Amazon Pay balance to cash?
faqs.a: The card’s earnings go to the Amazon account linked to the card. You can use the balance on eligible Amazon and Amazon Pay purchases. It cannot be withdrawn as cash or applied to your credit card statement.

faqs.q: Is there a cashback cap?
faqs.a: ICICI publishes no cap on eligible earnings. Merchant and product exclusions still apply, and the balance is credited to your linked Amazon account.

faqs.q: Amazon Pay ICICI vs HDFC Millennia for Amazon?
faqs.a: On eligible Amazon.in retail purchases, Amazon Pay ICICI pays 5% with Prime or 3% without Prime, with no stated cap. Millennia’s Amazon purchases share its 1,000-CashPoint calendar-month cap with the other named merchants. Check your Prime cost, expected rewards and how you would use each card’s credit.

faqs.q: Does HDFC Swiggy card give 10% on Swiggy Instamart?
faqs.a: Yes, eligible Instamart orders in the Swiggy app can earn 10% on the original card. Each transaction must be at least ₹249. Instamart shares the ₹1,500 billing-cycle cap with eligible Food Delivery and Dineout transactions.

faqs.q: Is the ₹100 minimum per order or per day?
faqs.a: It is per transaction for the 5% and 1% tiers. The eligible Swiggy app tier has its own ₹249 minimum per transaction, so ₹100 does not qualify an order for 10%.

faqs.q: HDFC Swiggy vs HDFC Millennia for food delivery?
faqs.a: Compare the specific order and remaining cap. The original Swiggy card can earn 10% on qualifying Swiggy app transactions of ₹249 or more, up to its ₹1,500 billing-cycle cap. Millennia can earn 5% in CashPoints on eligible Swiggy and Zomato orders, subject to its shared named-merchant calendar-month cap and redemption terms.
